court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Tuolumne
case_search_note: No general online case search found. Court Calendar: https://www.tuolumne.courts.ca.gov/online-services/court-calendars. Criminal Pay or Appear System (pay instead of appearing, eligible cases): https://apps.tuolumne.courts.ca.gov/Criminal. Record searches by request form, in person or mail ($15/name if over 10 minutes).

courthouses.name: Tuolumne County Superior Court — Justice Center Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; clerk counter 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; phones 8 a.m.–3 p.m.
courthouses.note: Only courthouse listed; hears criminal and traffic. Criminal Division (209) 533-5563 (8 a.m.–3 p.m.). Ask for a court-appointed attorney at arraignment. Remote appearances: https://www.tuolumne.courts.ca.gov/zoom

public_defenders.name: Tuolumne County Public Defender
public_defenders.note: Fax (209) 532-1185. Court decides indigency at arraignment (financial declaration). Represents adults on misdemeanors/felonies, plus juvenile 602, some dependency and conservatorship cases.

public_defenders.name: Tuolumne County Public Defender — Conflicts Division
public_defenders.note: Used when the Public Defender has a conflict. Chief Conflict Counsel lines: (209) 533-6679 and (209) 533-6680.

legal_aid.name: Central California Legal Services — Pro Bono Program (expungement clinic)
legal_aid.serves: People with convictions in Fresno, Tulare, Kings, Madera, Merced, Mariposa or Tuolumne County
legal_aid.what: Free legal information on criminal record expungement after a prescreen (clinic page dated Nov 2023 and marked archived).
legal_aid.todo: Page is archived — confirm the clinic is still running before referring

programs.name: Recovery Court
programs.summary: Collaborative court for non-violent participants with significant substance-abuse history; intake assessment then enrollment. Referral steps not published.

programs.name: Adult Alternative Sentencing (Work Program, Community Service, Sheriff's Parole, Electronic Monitoring)
programs.summary: Run by Probation at 465 S. Washington St., Sonora. Enrollment info in the page FAQs.

programs.name: Day Reporting Center
programs.summary: Probation program with GEO: cognitive behavioral therapy, MRT, drug treatment and testing, employment help, aftercare. 950 S. Washington St., Sonora.

jails.name: Dambacher Detention Center (Tuolumne County Jail)
jails.phone_note: Sheriff's Office Administration (28 N. Lower Sunset Drive, Sonora), Mon–Fri 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; Dispatch 24/7 (209) 533-5815. The jail page lists no direct jail number.
jails.note: Holds male and female inmates in eight housing units; designed for up to 230. Visits must be scheduled 24h ahead via SmartInmate (https://www.smartinmate.com/). Deposits/gift bags via Jail ATM. court_ids: nearest criminal courthouse, not confirmed.
jails.todo: Exact street address not on Sheriff page (county reports place it on Justice Center Dr, Sonora); visiting hours not published

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' (linked from insurance.ca.gov CheckAgntBrkr page) — look up any bail agent's license status. Tuolumne Sheriff jail page gives no bail procedure; call the Sheriff at (209) 533-5855.
